resources.string: Check your internet connection and try again.
Fast and private. Iranian sites see an Iranian address: they are reached through our server in Iran. A few Iranian sites and payment gateways may still refuse our server.
Slower, but websites can\'t see your IP. Some sites block Tor. Other apps on your phone can still find devices on your home network.
This mode is not available right now. Choose the other mode and try again.
Android did not let Chapar start the VPN. Allow the VPN request, or turn off another app\'s always-on VPN, then try again.
Use Iranian websites, apps and services that don\'t work from outside Iran. Free, no ads, no hassle.\nSign in with your Gmail account to connect.

We keep only a scrambled code made from your Google ID, your nickname, and how much data you use. Never your email, your IP address, or the sites you visit. Google sees that you signed in, and Chapar needs Google Play services. In Iran mode, Iranian sites (and their names) are reached through our server in Iran. In Tor mode we still see that you use Tor and how much data you use. You can delete your account in Settings.
Can\'t reach Chapar. Check your internet and try again.
Only Gmail accounts can use Chapar. Choose an @gmail.com account.
We\'ve reached the maximum number of users for now. Please try again later.
This nickname is taken. Try another one.
Chapar couldn\'t get your connection ready. Try again in a moment.
Sign-in didn\'t work. Please try again.
Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
Chapar is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
The connection to Chapar could not be checked as safe. Try another network.
We use it to greet you. Don\'t use your real name or a name people know you by online.
Your data is used up. It comes back on %1$s.
Your account is turned off. Your connection doesn\'t work right now.

This can\'t be undone. Your connection stops within a few minutes, and your nickname is deleted. Until the end of the month we keep only a scrambled code of your Google ID and this month\'s usage, so signing up again does not reset your data.
Could not delete your account. Try again.
See what happened and copy it to send when you ask for help.
This report has no keys, server addresses, or sites you visited. Copy it and send it to us if you need help.
Choose apps that use your own internet connection.

Apps you choose here use your real internet connection and your real address. They are not protected by Chapar. Android applies this to every app that shares a user ID with a chosen app (rare, mostly system apps).
In Android\'s VPN settings, tap the gear next to Chapar and turn on \"Always-on VPN\" and \"Block connections without VPN\". Then your real address is never used if the VPN drops.
Report a problem, suggest an idea, or tell us anything.
Connection events only, never the sites you visit.
We see your nickname with your message. Don\'t include personal details. Messages are deleted after 30 days.
Thank you. Your message was sent.
Your message could not be sent. Try again.
You can send up to 5 messages a day. Try again tomorrow.
